data.one_liner: Real-time Dio HTTP request/response logger with a web dashboard.
data.what_it_does: Intercepts Dio calls and records request and response details, then serves them via a local web dashboard. The dashboard shows headers, bodies, status codes and lets you copy cURL commands. It works on Android, iOS, macOS, Windows and Linux.
use_when: Testing API interactions with live visual feedback
avoid_when: Production builds where logged data could be exposed
Apps that need encrypted or authenticated logging
strengths: Zero code‑generation, just add an interceptor
Supports release builds via build‑time flag
weaknesses: Logs are unauthenticated and exposed on the local network
Works only with Dio, not other HTTP clients
data.setup_notes: Add cote_network_logger to pubspec, call await startNetworkLogServer() before runApp, add CoteNetworkLogger interceptor to Dio instance, ensure port 3000 is free.
